label: endophytic
definition: A host-associated trait in which a microbe resides within living internal plant tissues without causing apparent disease in the host.
observations: Plant-host-residence branch under host-associated; distinct from broader host association, root-surface rhizosphere association, plant-surface epiphytic residence, plant pathogenicity with apparent disease, saprotrophic residence on dead organic matter, and nitrogen-fixing symbiosis or growth-promotion phenotypes that apply to only some endophytic isolates.
